        If fileName <> ThisWorkbook.Name Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Set wbSource = Workbooks.Open(folderPath & fileName)
            On Error GoTo 0

            If Not wbSource Is Nothing Then
                ' Check if the target sheet exists, create it if not
                On Error Resume Next
                Set wsTarget = wbSource.Sheets(targetSheetName)
                On Error GoTo 0

                If wsTarget Is Nothing Then
                    Set wsTarget = wbSource.Sheets.Add(After:=wbSource.Sheets(wbSource.Sheets.Count))
                    wsTarget.Name = targetSheetName
                End If

                ' Copy the first sheet to the target sheet
                wbSource.Sheets(1).Copy After:=wbSource.Sheets(wbSource.Sheets.Count)

                ' Close the source workbook without saving changes
                wbSource.Close SaveChanges:=False
            End If
        End If
    Next fileName

    MsgBox "First sheets copied to sheet named 'All' in all .xlsx files.", vbInformation

    Set fso = Nothing

End Sub

Sub SortDataByColumnBDescending()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long

    ' Set the worksheet object
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Data")

    ' Find the last row in column A to determine the range size (assuming data starts at row 2)
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row

    Set dataRange = ws.Range("A1:Z" & lastRow) ' Adjust Z if your data goes further right

        .SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("B1"), SortOn:=xlSortOnValues, Order:=xlDescending, DataOption:=xlSortNormal
        .SetRange dataRange
        .Header = xlYes ' Indicates that the first row is a header
        .MatchCase = False
        .Orientation = xlTopToBottom
        .Apply
    End With

results.prompt: Write a script that lists the 10 largest files under C:\Data (recursively) with their size in MB.

results.draft:
```powershell
$source = 'C:\Logs'; $target = 'D:\Archive'; $since = (Get-Date).AddHours(-24)

Get-ChildItem -Path $source -Recurse -File -Filter '*.log' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $since } | ForEach-Object {
    $relative = $_.FullName.Substring($source.Length).TrimStart('\')
    $dest = Join-Path $target $relative
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $dest -Parent) -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $dest -Force
}
```
results.final:
```powershell
$source = 'C:\Logs'; $target = 'D:\Archive'; $since = (Get-Date).AddHours(-24)

Get-ChildItem -Path $source -Recurse -File -Filter '*.log' | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $since } | ForEach-Object {
    $relative = $_.FullName.Substring($source.Length).TrimStart('\')
    $dest = Join-Path $target $relative
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path $dest -Parent) -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Destination $dest -Force
}
```
